# clean

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/internal/clean"
```

Package clean is the logic behind the environments\-cleaner bot: housekeeping that keeps a repository's Actions footprint small. Its first task is pruning old workflow runs, which otherwise fill the self\-hosted runner node's disk.

<a name="PruneOptions"></a>
## type PruneOptions

PruneOptions configures PruneRuns.

```go
type PruneOptions struct {
    // Keep is how many of the newest runs to keep per workflow; older
    // completed runs are deleted. Negative is treated as zero.
    Keep int
    // DryRun only reports what it would delete.
    DryRun bool
}
```

<a name="PruneResult"></a>
## type PruneResult

PruneResult is the outcome of a PruneRuns.

```go
type PruneResult struct {
    Total   int
    Kept    int
    Deleted []github.WorkflowRun
    // Active is the number of not-completed runs left alone even though they
    // are beyond Keep (a run is never deleted while queued or in progress).
    Active int
}
```

<a name="PruneRuns"></a>
### func PruneRuns

```go
func PruneRuns(ctx context.Context, api API, opts PruneOptions) (PruneResult, error)
```

PruneRuns deletes completed workflow runs beyond the newest Keep per workflow, leaving recent history and never touching a run that is still queued or in progress. It is safe to repeat.
